blocks.text: Origin / creation. Philosophers, continuity experts, caregivers, world stewards, and small-awakening researchers formed a movement after increasing complexity failed to restore trusted transformation.
Identity / human status. Artificial political and ethical movement, not one founder.
Importance. They proposed preserving developmental capacity rather than full identity, maintaining meaningful vulnerability, and protecting an outside through the External Gate.

Decline or transformation. After the Resolution of Reduction, movement members became auditors, core designers, world fold stewards, gate architects, volunteers, or final witnesses. They then surrendered authority.

Final status / surviving function. The movement ended through withdrawal, death, dormancy, or reduction. Its principles structure cyber-pet cores and the Gate, but no Reductionist may claim a later pet as continuation property.
